response: The internet originated in the 1960s with US Defense-funded research, leading to ARPANET’s first message in 1969 and the foundational adoption of TCP/IP protocols in 1983. Tim Berners-Lee created the World Wide Web in 1989, and the 1993 Mosaic browser brought it to the public, fueling the dot-com boom and eventual 2001 crash that still produced giants like Amazon and Google. The mid-2000s saw social media and the 2007 iPhone launch drive mobile and ubiquitous connectivity, while cloud computing took off with AWS in 2006. Today, the internet connects over 5 billion people and underpins nearly all facets of modern life.
